classification.difficultyReason: Calculate two shift durations, combine the weekly hours and apply an hourly wage.

content.prompt: Charlie works from 7:30 am to 3 pm Monday to Wednesday and from 8 am to 4 pm Thursday and Friday. His hourly rate is \$27. Calculate his weekly wage.

answer.worked:
Monday to Wednesday: $7.5$ hours each day. Thursday and Friday: $8$ hours each day.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Weekly hours}&=3\times7.5+2\times8\\\text{Weekly hours}&=38.5\\\text{Weekly wage}&=\$27\times38.5\\\text{Weekly wage}&=\$1039.50\end{align*}$$
